Name: Frozen Cherry
Desc:
The method takes inspiration from ingredients outside of coffee which develop amazing natural sweetness thanks to freezing temperatures. Inspired by the wine industry, whole cherries are fermented and put in a freezer in bags so the sugars accumulate. Further removed and slow dried on raised beds.    
   Origin - Baarbara, Chikmagalur, Karnataka   
   Altitude - 4500 ft - 5000 ft   
   Varietal - SLN 795   
   Roasted for - Filter    
   Recommended Brewing Equipment - Pour Over and Aeropress        
   Taste Notes - Juicy Mango, Mixed berries

Name: Intenso Fermentation
Process: Whole Beans / 250 grams is backordered and will ship as soon as it is back in stock. This nano-lot from Baarbara
Desc:
This nano-lot from Baarbara Estate was produced by adding yeast to the ripened cherries in a controlled environment. The fermentation process results in notes of candied fruits and berries in the cup with a prominent acidity and complexity.   
  This is the first year we experiment with yeast fermentation. For this lot, we chose a yeast called Intenso (Saccharomyces cerevisiae), intended to increase fruity flavours, mouthfeel and general cup quality.   
  We found a floral aroma and notes of pomegranate, cherry, candied fruit and a hints of prunes supported by a smooth mouthfeel and the best way to enjoy this is to either brew a pour over or an iced coffee.   
  We have cupped this coffee multiple times in different stages of harvest and roast profiles. It can be strange and puzzling (in a nice way) because the flavours are constantly developing. It's like watching your favourite movie, that you've forgotten.    
   Origin - Single Origin    
   Altitude - 4500 ft - 5000 ft    
   Varietal - SLN 795    
   Roasted for - Filter    
   Best brewed as -Pour Over and Iced Coffees      
   Taste Notes - Pomegranate, Cherry, Candied Fruit & Prunes

Name: Mixed Fruit Fermentation
Desc:
This nano-lot from Baarbara Estate showcases a unique mixed-fruit fermentation; where handpicked ripened cherries are washed in natural spring water and fermented alongside pineapple, papaya, and watermelon in stainless steel tanks. The process is closely monitored for pH and temperature to ensure consistency, with a 1:2 coffee-to-fruit ratio enhancing complexity. Once fermentation is complete, the pulped coffee is sun-dried on raised beds to achieve the perfect moisture level. The result is a lively, tropical coffee with notes of pineapple, honey, sweet lime, and tangerine; offering both brightness and balance in the cup. Our favourite lot this year - we also like to call it a Fruit Punch!    
   Origin - Baarbara, Chikmagalur, Karnataka   
   Altitude - 4500 ft - 5000 ft   
   Varietal - SLN 795   
   Roasted for - Filter    
   Recommended Brewing Equipment - Pour Over (V60/Kalita), Aeropress     
   Taste Notes - Pineapple, Honey, Sweet Lime, Tangerine
